title: Atlassian deepens its OpenAI partnership with a spend commitment — but its platform stays firmly multi-model
key_facts: Atlassian and OpenAI each published a post on 6 Oct 2026 about an expanded partnership building on a collaboration begun in 2023.
OpenAI's post: its frontier models will power agents across Atlassian's platform and Rovo, including the GPT-6 family and the GPT-5.6 series.
Atlassian's post: new OpenAI capabilities are added to the mix of models across Rovo and the broader platform.
Neither post, as FourWeekMBA read them, gives a price, a contract length or a dollar value.
Both describe ChatGPT and Codex reaching Atlassian work through plugins backed by the Teamwork Graph, and say more than 3,000 Atlassian developers use Codex.
OpenAI says it will continue to rely on Jira to manage workflows.
quote_evidence: Under a new agreement, OpenAI frontier models will power agents across Atlassian's platform and Rovo.
New frontier capabilities from OpenAI are consistently added to the mix of models across Rovo and the broader Atlassian platform.
why_it_matters_hint: Wider OpenAI-Atlassian deal; platform stays multi-model; no price published.
notes: VentureBeat blocked (429). Source set to AI News Desk: built from VentureBeat's headline, FourWeekMBA's reading of the Atlassian and OpenAI posts, and the Atlassian blog link. The 'spend commitment' appears only in VentureBeat's headline.
